Tells PeekLUT what your footage was shot in and what it should look like on screen. Most users can leave this on Off. It's only needed when shooting in a flat "log" profile such as Apple Log, ARRI LogC, Sony S-Log3, Fuji F-Log, or RED Log3G10. Pick the matching preset to convert log footage back to a normal-looking image, or use the Input and Output tabs to set things manually.

• **Improved HSL Qualifier**: Rebuilt hue detection now ignores washed-out pixels, keeping selections clean even on skin tones and muted colors.

• **Masks**: Major improvements across mask editing, including draw masks, mask merging, and multiple blend modes.
• **Draw Masks**: Paint precise mask areas directly for more control over local adjustments.
• **Color Shift and Dehaze**: Improved results for cleaner color separation and more natural haze reduction.
• **Film Contrast**: New film contrast controls with Centre, Shadow Toe, Highlight Shoulder, and contrast shaping.

• Support for LUT_3D_SIZE 65 and 64. Minor improments underhood to LUT loading
• Fullscreen support for photos and video
• Fix a bug that would cause exporting videos shot on iPhone with spatial audio support to fail
• Moved presets to its own button in the tab
